text:
Jordan: quick follow-up from the postmortem on missing spans / bad aggregation / ETL lag. want a single source of truth for owners + deadlines. who can lead the tracker?
Alex: I'll take the tracker and link all PRs + cards. propose three swimlanes: spans, aggregation, etl. I'll be the coordinator.
Priya: happy to pick up spans fixes (schema validation + extra instrumentation). estimate ~5 working days to get a staged canary.
Matt: I'll handle aggregation correctness (dedupe keys + windowing logic). found suspicious reducer logs: 
```
2026-03-22T08:12:34Z aggregator ERROR reconciliation: inconsistent-merge-key id=abcd1234 window=60s
```
need about 8-11 days for fixes + regression tests.
Samira: I'll own ETL lag RCA and the scheduler/backpressure mitigation. pattern: batch overlap with nightly backup causes queue pileup. short term: stagger windows; long term: implement token-bucket limiter.
Alex: tentative targets on the tracker: 
- Spans (Priya) target 2026-03-30
- Aggregation (Matt) target 2026-04-06
- ETL (Samira) short-term done, long-term target 2026-04-08
I will create cards with CI gates and rollback criteria.
Priya: prefer a canary rollout for spans: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. will add telemetry flags and health metrics.
Matt: +1 to canary. I'll add a 30-day historical regression job in CI to compare daily aggregation totals pre/post change.
Samira: pushed a low-risk staggered schedule to prod (monitoring enabled) and opened an infra card for token-bucket work. short-term alert: queue_depth > 80% triggers page.
oncall-bot: Incident 1849123456 RESOLVED by oncall.
Jordan: thanks. Alex please add explicit rollback triggers to each card (latency > 2x baseline OR error rate > 1%). Also add weekly status check-ins until all cards closed.
Alex: done 97 board created and cards assigned: https://redwood.internal/boards/obs-remediations (internal). added checklist items: PR link, canary steps, perf/regression job, rollback criteria.
Priya: opening PR today: "spans: schema validation + canary instrumentation". will include feature flag and smoke tests.
Matt: will open aggregation PR tomorrow; includes unit tests and the 30-day regression script.
Samira: follow-ups: created card for token-bucket infra with metrics hooks; will coordinate with Matt for instrumentation.
Jordan: action summary ->
- Alex: create + own tracker/board (in progress)
- Priya: missing spans schema + canary (target 2026-03-30)
- Matt: aggregation dedupe/windowing + regression tests (target 2026-04-06)
- Samira: ETL stagger deployed; backpressure long-term (target 2026-04-08)
We'll do a 15-min check-in Friday. if anything slips, DM me. :thumbsup:
